title: Microstate treatments & accessibility pass for compact cost + rollout tiles — final review and dev handoff
creator: Maya Chen
description: Finalize microstate visual treatments, keyboard focus/aria patterns, and accessibility contrast fixes for the compact cost cards and rollout timeline tiles on the Console dashboard. Create definitive motion and token exports for engineering, document known edge cases (small widths, low-bandwidth streaming), and incorporate stakeholder redlines prior to QA run and dev implementation.
acceptance_criteria: All compact cost and rollout tile microstates (default, hover, active, focus, disabled, loading, error) have finalized specs in Figma with token references
Color contrast for all text and icons meets WCAG AA for normal text and 3:1 for non-text contrast where applicable
Keyboard and screen-reader behavior documented (tab order, aria-labels, live regions for rollout status updates)
Prototype demonstrates motion durations and easing; engineering has exported Lottie or motion spec where required
Design handoff checklist completed and PR linked; dev has acknowledged by assigning ENG-2201 and creating subtask for token implementation
developer_handoff: Exported token palette: color, elevation, spacing, type-scale — doc attached in Confluence
Motion spec: durations (100ms hover, 220ms open/close), easing = cubic-bezier(0.2,0.9,0.25,1.0)
Notes: small-width breakpoint <600px collapses sparkline to icon-only; dev to implement aria-expanded on collapse toggle
qa_notes: Run on Chrome, Safari, and Firefox latest; mobile viewport emulation (360x800) and 768px tablet breakpoint
Verify keyboard order: tile -> primary action -> overflow menu -> next tile
Simulate network throttling to validate loading microstate and skeletons
Contrast checks: primary label >= 4.5:1, secondary label >= 3:1
Regression tests: ensure rollout failure state shows retry CTA and emits telemetry event 'rollout.retry.clicked'
comments: 2026-02-22 | Maya Chen: Initial pass uploaded to Figma. Included 6 microstates for each tile and a compact variant for dense dashboards. Requested PM review for priority cases.
2026-02-25 | Arjun Patel (PM): Liked the reduced density but asked that we preserve per-token cost drilldown access — added overflow menu pattern to designs.

2026-03-01 | Liam Ortega (Design): Implemented updated overflow menu and added aria-labels. Noted trade-off: to maintain contrast we increased body font weight from 400 to 500 on dense layouts; validated with accessibility team.

2026-03-03 | Accessibility Team (review): Flagged color token 'neutral-300' as failing AA for icon on light background. Recommendation: replace with 'neutral-400' and retest. Also suggested focus ring color to be brand-500 at 3px inset.

2026-03-05 | Maya Chen: Applied accessibility redlines; adjusted elevation shadows to 1px/2px rather than the original 3px to reduce visual noise. This changed perceived depth — recorded decision in Confluence.

2026-03-07 | Eng Lead (Sofia R.): Noted engineering constraint: continuous batching server-side telemetry spikes when rollout tiles update more than 6 times/sec. Suggested debounce for live updates at 500ms. Recording as ENG-2258 dependency.
2026-03-09 | Liam Ortega: Updated motion spec to 220ms for open/close to align with platform tokens; added fallback static state for clients that disable motion.

2026-03-11 | QA (Jordan M.): Performed exploratory pass on prototype. Found edge case: in reduced-motion mode, focus outline becomes invisible due to token mismatch — added QA task to verify focus visible for reduced-motion users.

2026-03-12 | Maya Chen: Final review meeting notes: PM approved overflow pattern; Eng confirmed feasibility of tokens and motion fallback. Next: formal handoff package and create ENG subtasks for token mapping and keyboard support.
next_steps: Attach exported token JSON to Confluence page and ping ENG-2201 for mapping
Create ENG subtasks for keyboard interactions and debounce behavior (ENG-2269, ENG-2270)
Schedule 30-min dev handoff on 2026-03-16 to walk through microstates and QA checklist
Close loop with Accessibility team after dev build (target 2026-03-20) and update release notes
